formatNumber

Function to format large numbers with abbreviated suffixes (K, M, B, T).

Example
import formatNumber from '@/utils/formatNumber'

formatNumber(0)
// output: '0'

formatNumber(999)
// output: '999'

formatNumber(1000)
// output: '1.00K'

formatNumber(1500000)
// output: '1.50M'

formatNumber(2500000000)
// output: '2.50B'

formatNumber(1234567890123)
// output: '1.23T'

// Custom decimals
formatNumber(1500000, 1)
// output: '1.5M'

Params
PARAM	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
value	The numeric value to format.	number	-
decimals	Number of decimal places in the result.	number	2
Return
RETURN	DESCRIPTION	TYPE	DEFAULT
formattedNumber	The formatted number string with suffix.	string	-
